source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-32

procedures.title: Axle drive shaft: remove, repair and install
steps: Removal: disconnect the inboard trunnion of the drive shaft from the side gear yoke.
Bend the bolt lock tabs down and remove the 4 bolts holding the shaft flange to the spindle drive flange.
Pry the shaft out of the outboard drive flange pilot and take it out outboard end first (see figure 82 in the manual).
notes: Figure 81 in the manual shows the axle drive shaft assembly.
